charter: FULL_PROJECT_AUDIT.md §4 (Layering, state ownership, coupling, error boundaries, store contracts)
question: Is it well-bounded? Can a contributor test/change one layer without understanding all layers?
verdict: Yes — with caveats: decompiler/transpiler/runtime are cleanly bounded and node-testable; engine owns DisplayNode queues but leaks via two globals (globalDebugger, RT.host + MovieClip.__construct hook) and a shared AssetCache dispose bound to App.packages. App+CodeWorkspace+Execute prop-drill doc/cache/project; ProjectResult→AS2Program→Player one-way contract holds. 9 ARCH advisories, 0 blockers.

stateOwners: stateless pure parse: bytes/XML -> SwfDocument + SwfFile[] + warnings + stats; Parser class local to call
ioBoundary: none — caller supplies bytes/XML; DecompressionStream('deflate') only for CWS inflates
errorBoundary: parseTags throws on truncated; parseSwfXml surfaces parsererror; parseSwfBinary throws ZWS; per-tag try/catch -> warnings

ioBoundary: none — path routing via regex on __Packages/DefineSprite_13/%3Cdefault package%3E
errorBoundary: per-file LexError/ParseError -> FileReport.diagnostics; unmapped -> warning; tagOrder/targetSpriteId preserved

errorBoundary: guard() try/catch + avm1 budget 150ms; takeAvm1Warnings diagnostics

stateOwners: AS2Player owns DisplayNode tree + queue + timers+clock + audio/channels + sockets + mouse/keys/focus + logs; tick(): walk->enterFrame->advance->runQueue->syncTexts->onTick
ioBoundary: canvas.getContext('2d') + HtmlAudioElement + fetchText->mockNetwork + TextMeasurer(canvas) + resolveExternal(async) + registerFonts
errorBoundary: guard/runGuardFn + globalDebugger push/pop + reportProblem + breakOnException; queue overflow >200k; dispose() clears sockets/timers/queue+RT.host

ioBoundary: same canvas/audio/file trio as AS2 + compileSources(new Function/esm eval) + failLoad(URLLoader offline block)
errorBoundary: reportError cap 200 + ScriptAbort rethrow + runtime.guard + debug pause on exception; scheduled loop 1000 iter cap; dispose clears listeners/channels/timers

errorBoundary: ErrorBoundary per workspace resetKeys=[doc,workspace]; try/catch in load/loadBundled -> error state; packageLabels soft-fail bundled merge

errorBoundary: status==='failed' -> 'Project load failed'; rows.length===0 -> 'No files match'; exportTypeScript try/catch -> exportError; outer App ErrorBoundary catches CodePanel render errors

stateOwners: playerRef:ref<AS2Player/FlashPlayer> + session/playing/muted/hud/tree/missing/logs/displayTree/highlightedIds/runtimeTimelines/loadedExternals/boot/fontIds/viewFile; raf loop requestAnimationFrame @100ms HUD; RunningTimelinesSidebar activeTab local + derived activeAssets/actorStates from live runningTimelines/doc/project.cache+displayTree
ioBoundary: all player I/O: AS2Player(audio,cache,assets,fontFamily,resolveExternal,fetchText->mockServer) + FlashPlayer(cache,audio,program->linkProgram compile); DebugPanel -> globalDebugger pause/step/continue
errorBoundary: executionFaultRef drops tick on first throw + reportError('Execute animation/render loop'); pendingLogs batch; outer ErrorBoundary catches mount failures

errorBoundary: AssetCache.load* -> {status:'error'}; swfLoading per-file try/catch -> warnings+unknownTags; MockServer.connect no-op offline; loader returns LinkedProgramError[] not throw

findings.evidence: selectSwf swaps cacheRef+doc atomically; buildPackage onChange->tick bridges assets<->cache but cache.load* async may resolve after activeSwfIndex switched
findings.disposition: Tolerate — packages.filter(c=>cache.dispose()) closes race; follow-up generation check on AssetCache.finish()

findings.evidence: 5 circulars (runtime actor, flash context/events, flash player/context, as2 player/builtins, gameServerStub/mockNetwork), 1 orphan main.tsx
findings.disposition: Tolerate — layer-internal cycles; splitting DisplayNode into type-only types.ts would drop 2 cycles at churn cost not justified before P2

findings.evidence: globalDebugger singleton holds one DebuggerCallbacks; last useEffect to mount wins, so F5 Continue from Code Inspector could resume wrong player after pausing (only one workspace mounted at a time in App:workspace, so low live repro, but Popout portals duplicate)
findings.disposition: Defer/guard — Map<string,Callbacks>+activeWorkspace slot or assert prev==null on setCallbacks; move store into App useRef via context rather than module export

findings.evidence: Flash constructs clip before class new Ctor() body via MovieClip.__construct=build hook; second AS2Player in same jsdom can clobber host/__construct between ticks
findings.disposition: Tolerate — mitigated by try/finally + bind fallback in instantiate; add afterEach(RT.installHost(null)) to as2player.test.ts

findings.evidence: AS2Clip {[key:string]:any} by spec (this._x/_visible/_global.sushi); any at value seam not layer seam; tsc 0 with eslint-disable header
findings.disposition: Keep (reasoned debt) — narrow to AS2Value/unknown where util, not at runtime boundary; no new any in phase

findings.disposition: Defer — add clearTintCache()/prune; saving <2MB, not a leak (GC on canvas release)

findings.evidence: DebuggerStore.emit() loops [...listeners] with no try/catch; DebugPanel:evaluateWatch(new Function) catches user errors but listener throw would unwind players
findings.disposition: Tolerate — one-liner guard try/catch per listener in emit() follow-up

findings.disposition: Keep — DebuggerProvider is the one scoped Context; keep drill for doc/cache/project until second top-level consumer appears
